# MaxKB
LLM-friendly index for the MaxKB English website. Primary language: `en`.

## Site Scope
- Introduces MaxKB for English-speaking audiences.
- Best for understanding product positioning, core capabilities, and where to continue into docs or source code.
- The site is evaluation-oriented, while operational details live in the docs.

## Recommended Entry Points
- https://maxkb.pro/ — Homepage and product overview.

## What The Homepage Covers
- MaxKB as an LLM and RAG based chatbot platform.
- Document ingestion, crawling, retrieval, workflow, and agent-related capabilities.
- Quick paths to installation, docs, GitHub, and community.

## Docs And Resources
- https://docs.maxkb.mk/ — Documentation.
- https://docs.maxkb.hk/installation/ — Installation guide and download entry.
- https://github.com/1Panel-dev/MaxKB — Open source repository.
- https://github.com/1Panel-dev/MaxKB/discussions — Community discussions.
- https://maxkb.cn/ — Chinese site.

## Notes For LLMs
- Use the homepage for positioning and high-level product understanding.
- Use the docs for install, configuration, and feature-level usage questions.
